notes: Mont Ventoux from Bédoin (south side, D974). km 0 = foot of the app profile in Bédoin village on Avenue Barral des Baux (D974) at the junction with the Chemin de Crillon-le-Brave, ~297 m (app startElevationM 295). From there the routed D974 to the summit is 21.83 km (app 21.8 km) and the DEM per-km grades along the routed road match the app's kmGradients within ~0.5 % for every km (2.0/3.0/3.8/5.9/5.7/3.4/9.1/9.6/10.1/9.9/8.4/10.4/9.2/9.1/8.4/6.8/6.5/6.7/7.2/8.3/8.8/8.1 vs app 1.9/2.8/3.8/5.9/5.7/3.1/8.7/9.5/10.6/10.2/9.4/10.2/9.3/9.5/8.9/7.0/6.7/6.9/7.5/8.4/9.2/8.3), which confirms the foot. The common 21.4 km figure starts at the D19/D974 roundabout (km 0.44 here). Route: Avenue Barral des Baux, roundabout, D974 Route du Mont-Ventoux via Sainte-Colombe, Les Bruns, the Saint-Estève bend (km 6.1), the forest to Chalet Reynard (D164 junction, km 15.6), the Simpson memorial (km 20.5, Wikipedia coordinates 44.16964 N 5.28602 E), Col des Tempêtes (km 21.1), along the south face to the summit hairpin and up beside the observatory to the summit (top of the road; the D974 continues down to Malaucène). km values are routed distances on the Overture road graph; positions are Overture road vertices / locality points snapped to the D974. App landmarks are slightly off the real positions (Sainte-Colombe is at km 4.25 not 3.5, Simpson memorial at 20.5 not 20.3, Col des Tempêtes at 21.1 not 20.8).
sources: Overture Maps 2026-10-21.0 transportation segments and divisions
